name: Kofi Mensah
demo_note: Fictional persona — synthetic demo data only. Not a real person, no real records.
summary_line: 17, care-experienced; strong interest in trades; misses appointments but turns up for hands-on work.

records.source: Leaving Care Team — Personal Adviser note
records.author: D. Whitfield (PA)
records.text: Kofi moved to semi-independent accommodation in October. Settling unevenly. Disengaged from the last two formal review meetings — does not respond well to office settings or paperwork. Pathway plan target: education/training by spring.

records.author: Sam Ellison (Keyworker)
records.text: Met Kofi at the workshop rather than the office — completely different person there. Confident, good with his hands, asked sharp questions about apprenticeships. Hates being 'talked at'. Phone is often out of credit so texts don't always land; WhatsApp works better.

records.author: G. Obi (Supervisor)
records.text: Two-day taster. Punctual both days, polite, picked things up fast. Would consider him for an apprenticeship if he can get his Level 1 maths. One no-show the following week with no message.

records.author: system
records.text: Missed scheduled call (3rd missed appointment this quarter). Re-contacted via WhatsApp same day — replied within the hour, apologised, said he forgot.
